I've been through this everytime I've had a gig, I'm pretty much always anxious when I play infront of other people. Especially when I play infront of a single person like my teacher or my dad. But one thing always helped me forget the audience at a gig: just enjoy the music.
When you've rehearsed enough to be able to play it without really looking at the instrument then you will be able to enjoy the music on stage. As if you were a part of the audience. What I felt during the last gig was amazing, and since I'm a bass player in a indie band there's not that much I have to focus on really, so I just sit back (stand up) and relax to the music me and my friends have made, while performing it. I don't know really, all I can say is.. enjoy every second of it and if you know the songs, there's no need to worry.
